method: Blind human picks: for episodes 4, 14, 24, 34, 44 (every 10th, fixed rule, no cherry-picking) I read the script and chose the single best 20-60s promo before looking at the tool's output. Hook/cliffhanger notes are paraphrased (no script text).

promos.hook: a stranger tells the jilted bride she was betrayed, not worthless
promos.cliffhanger: she admits she does not know him: will she accept?

promos.hook: her bloodied hands after freeing her husband
promos.cliffhanger: his look turns to silent revenge

promos.hook: a noblewoman tells the new maid her opinion does not matter
promos.cliffhanger: she silently vows to return and heal
she admits it in court: verdict pending

promos.hook: his ex says she mourned him for three years
promos.cliffhanger: she is stunned by who he chose
